study_scope: Chen 2026 MI versus Wu 2026 TAC: immune cell identity, transcriptomic acquisition, intervention timing and strict post-established-scar EXIT

predecessor.dedup_note: These two published studies already registered and alerted. This artifact adds primary-method verification and disambiguates Wu's human versus mouse GEO roots; it must not be counted as independent discovery or replication.

CHEN_MI.verified_tissue: mouse heart after LAD myocardial infarction; also NHP MI and human peripheral-blood phenotype

cellular_atlas.main_report: gamma-delta-related T cells prominent among cardiac PD1-positive populations; PD1-positive CD4 and CD8 also expand, no single exclusive origin

GSE292863.design: Mouse heart sorted PD1-positive vs PD1-negative T-cell bulk RNA-seq 7 days after MI

GSE293489.design: Mouse post-MI/sham scRNA-seq and relevant T-cell study

intervention.note: Day14 repeat dose is not a new randomized delayed-start arm because the same NHP already received pretreatment at day -1.

fibroblast_mechanism.proposed_source: CXCL9 from cardiac PD1-positive activated T cells
outcomes: less Sirius-red fibrosis with pre-injury anti-PD1 or congenital knockout
lower bulk alpha-SMA, COL1, POSTN markers

CHEN_MI.author_explicit_caveat: The Discussion states delayed administration following acute inflammatory phase and optimal window require future studies.

WU_TAC.verified_model: Mouse transverse-aortic constriction (TAC) and anti-PD1-related cardiac injury; separately observed human PBMC anti-PD1 side effects

mechanism.chemokine_producer: Cardiac fibroblasts make CXCL9/CXCL10 under TAC
mechanism.injury_effectors: GZMB / perforin, cardiomyocyte mitochondrial complex-I impairment and apoptosis
perturbations: CD8- and T-cell Pdcd1 conditional genetic loss
mechanism.reported_consequence: anti-PD1 worsens TAC-associated injury; CXCR3/GZMB interventions rescue injury in investigated settings
mechanism.limitation: rescue of immune cardiotoxicity is not demonstration of reversal of pre-existing mature myocardial fibrosis

mouse_Tac.assay: RNA-seq with TAC context; GSM list, contrasts and sequencing unit require direct GEO inspection

human_anti_pd1_PBMC.tissue: peripheral blood mononuclear cells, NOT mouse hearts
human_anti_pd1_PBMC.cohort_current_metadata: 7 possible-myocarditis vs 7 anti-PD1-exposed without cardiac injury
human_anti_pd1_PBMC.caution: Older GSM records report 4+3 cohort, but newer samples and BioProject support 7+7. Verify exact sample release/version before reanalysis, no blind merge or duplicated original libraries.

independent_replay_status.reason: Execution environment cannot reach NCBI FTP/Zenodo binaries through network; source indexes and published paper HTML were inspected but downloadable matrix bytes were not obtained.
independent_replay_status.attempt_note: Direct HTTPS from container to ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, zenodo.org failed with network connection errors; do not infer data are unavailable to the public.

possible_comparison_after_acquisition.model_separation: Compute MI mouse and TAC mouse analyses separately; never pool conditions, endpoints or infer model×drug interaction without a factorial matched model.
possible_comparison_after_acquisition.cell_ontology: Use full cell state reference plus orthogonal flow or TCR gating; do not equate one-marker RNA+ to a cell subtype and do not count cells as biological replicates.
possible_comparison_after_acquisition.statistical_unit: individual independent mouse for mouse study; independently sampled human participant for PBMC study; unknown pooling blocks inferential p-values
plots: per-mouse fraction TRDC-positive T cells and CD8 cytotoxic state, each with denominator
per-mouse CXCR3 and effector expression by T subtype
per-animal vs per-cell effect and confidence intervals
CXCL9/CXCL10 ligand source vs CXCR3 receptor recipient, separately by disease model
possible_comparison_after_acquisition.recipient_source_direction: CHEN proposed ligand source PD1+ T -> fibroblast CXCR3; WU proposed fibroblast CXCL9/10 -> CD8 CXCR3. Matching ligand-receptor family does not prove same directed mechanism.
possible_comparison_after_acquisition.type_caution: Human GSE328788 PBMC cannot answer native murine cardiac fibroblast EXIT; species, tissue and sampling context differ.

prior_art_context.claim: Previous neonatal heart PD1/PD-L1 immune-regeneration study reports disruption of neonatal regeneration when PD1/PD-L1 is deleted; age/state context differs from adult MI and TAC
prior_art_context.implication: The sign of checkpoint signaling depends on development, injury model and cell-specific roles.

strict_delayed_exit_gate.definition: To pass, recruit animals with VERIFIED scar/fibroblast-activation before treatment randomization; after intervention, track independent animal-level ECM, lineage-traced profibrotic-state occupancy, state fate/clearance, maintained myocardial integrity and functional rescue longitudinally.

next_actions: Acquire Chen GSE292863 sorted-T-cell bulk and GSE293489 scRNA sample manifests and processed count matrices, including original true animal IDs; archive SHA256.
Acquire Wu GSE327655 mouse-TAC sample-level design/count matrices and separately 14 human PBMC GSM records; do not substitute one for the other.
Retrieve Zenodo preprocess.R first (19.3 kB), validate MD5 against c09afc0f77fa13f63329de811f208f59, inspect for sample and group mapping before fetching 31.9GB RDS.
Reproduce within-study differential expression and T subset proportions at biological-animal/participant unit; cross-compare only direction/specificity with explicitly different contexts.

Find or preregister delayed-start intervention in established scar with pre-randomization histology/imaging, time courses, lineage fate and ECM stiffness plus safety endpoints; neither 2026 paper qualifies for EXIT.
